assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-oriented 2D pixel-art character animation assets for a cafe construction simulator.
Input image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY AND ART STYLE REFERENCE. Preserve the exact adult worker identity: dark short hair, ochre yellow hard hat, orange reflective vest, navy blue work clothes, brown pouch belt, charcoal boots, light-medium skin, small gray hammer held in the same right hand. Keep the same moderately large head, face, costume, colors, hard dark pixel outlines, pixel size, and elevated three-quarter isometric view facing screen-right/southeast. Crisp genuine 2D pixel art with hard square pixel clusters and a limited palette, no 3D rendering, no vector smoothness.
The character must be reusable in a game. Real transparent alpha background. Remove the gray floor tile from the reference completely. No environment, floor, platform, shadow, background color, checkerboard painted into the artwork, text, numbering, labels, borders, or decorative elements. Fully visible head, hands, hammer and boots, none cropped.
Primary request: create ONE isolated full-body sprite of this same worker standing idle, both feet naturally planted, arms relaxed, hammer hanging down. Centered on a square transparent canvas with comfortable empty margins. The output is exactly one character, not a sheet. Keep the reference design very close. This is the neutral standing pose that will match a walking animation of the same character.

Asset type: production-oriented 2D pixel-art character animation assets for a cafe construction simulator.
Input image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY AND ART STYLE REFERENCE. Preserve the exact adult worker identity: dark short hair, ochre yellow hard hat, orange reflective vest, navy blue work clothes, brown pouch belt, charcoal boots, light-medium skin, small gray hammer held in the same right hand. Keep the same moderately large head, face, costume, colors, hard dark pixel outlines, pixel size, and elevated three-quarter isometric view facing screen-right/southeast. Crisp genuine 2D pixel art with hard square pixel clusters and a limited palette, no 3D rendering, no vector smoothness.
The character must be reusable in a game. Real transparent alpha background. Remove the gray floor tile from the reference completely. No environment, floor, platform, shadow, background color, checkerboard painted into the artwork, text, numbering, labels, borders, or decorative elements. Fully visible head, hands, hammer and boots, none cropped.
Primary request: produce a STRICT GAME SPRITE SHEET of exactly EIGHT consecutive frames of ONE WALK CYCLE of the SAME worker. Canvas square, arranged as EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS by TWO EQUAL ROWS, no labels or visible grid. Each of the eight equal cells contains one complete sprite, matching the same scale and proportions. Cell centers equally spaced at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% of canvas width. Row centers at 25% and 75% of canvas height. Allow transparent margins around every sprite. Keep every sprite INSIDE its own cell, with zero crossing/overlap, and identical local pelvis position and foot-ground anchor. All eight characters MUST face the same screen-right/southeast direction; do not turn the head or body between frames.
Frame order left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row:
1. Contact A: near leg forward, far leg back; arms counter-swing.
2. Down A: weight settles onto forward foot, rear heel lifting.
3. Passing A: rear leg passes under pelvis, bent knee; stance foot under body.
4. Up A: moving leg comes forward, trailing foot begins push-off.
5. Contact B: opposite leg forward, first leg back; opposite arm swing.
6. Down B: weight settles on opposite foot.
7. Passing B: first leg passes under pelvis, bent knee.
8. Up B: first leg comes forward, returning seamlessly toward frame 1.
This MUST look like successive phases of walking IN PLACE, not eight static duplicates. Alternate the leg and arm positions clearly while keeping helmet, head, torso shape, clothes and tool identity consistent. Avoid large body bobbing, stretchy limbs, changing height or costume. Hammer stays attached to the same hand and swings a little with the arm. Natural short worker strides, not running or marching. Keep feet, hands, and hammer simple and readable. Output ONLY the transparent 4-by-2 animation sprite atlas.
